Priest Booked in Mangaluru for Alleged Sexual Assault of Minors

A Catholic priest at St. Vincent Ferrar Church in Valencia, Mangaluru, has been booked under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act for allegedly sexually assaulting five minor boys. The complainant reportedly shared details with his parents, who then approached the Bishop of Mangaluru. The Bishop advised the boy to file a police complaint.
